subject: The lamp I received is not genuine
snippet: I ordered a Halo Pendant from what I thought was your website but the brass is painted plastic and the box had no guarantee card. I paid 78 dollars on lumengoods-outlet.example. Is that you?
_expect: COMPLAINT — genuine counterfeit signal, names a lookalike domain and a below-floor price

subject: Wrong item / fake?
snippet: This arrived with a different cable and the finish is wrong. I bought it from a seller on a marketplace called Lumen Goods Outlet Store. Can you confirm whether they are authorised?

subject: The Next Twelve Months of Enterprise AI
snippet: One of the most striking aspects of this cycle is how much of the demand is fake, and how hard it has become to tell counterfeit traction from the real thing.
_expect: NOT a complaint — F1/A3. This is the exact false-positive shape observed in the real Gmail probe: a newsletter matching on 'fake' and 'counterfeit'.
